scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate dark palette and single muted-blue accent show design intent, but the force-directed network is too dense to read individual nodes at rendered size and the color-usage scatter is visually overwhelming without a clear entry point.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bars, scaleSqrt for all circle encodings, data-driven domains throughout, monthly binning, no dual axes; y-axis fixed to full-dataset max (intentional for comparison) means filtered foreground bars render against a stable scale, satisfying subset robustness.
scores.stress_test_note: Exemplary dirty-flag+RAF pattern and canvas rendering prevent update storms; pointer events avoid touch fights; no transitions eliminate mid-flight snaps; only gap is that brush scale closures are captured at init with no ResizeObserver, so a window resize would silently produce wrong pixel-to-value mappings.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views and a 60-node force network are within working memory limits, but the color-usage panel renders hundreds of simultaneous distinct hues as a dense dot field, making it impossible to extract a pattern at a glance rather than just perceiving visual noise.
